svg.title: About
svg.desc: AI & ML undergraduate at Ramaiah Institute of Technology. I've done applied deep-learning research at Samsung R&D and DRDO, published in IEEE, and shipped production apps used across mobile and web. I like problems where models meet hardware, data pipelines and real users. Education: MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology, B.E. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning · 2023 – 2027.
